definitions.explanation: A distinctive set of clothes worn by members of the same organization, school, or workplace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制服|せいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
{制服|せいふく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I wash my uniform every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{制服|せいふく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。

notes:
{制服|せいふく} combines ⟦{制|せい}→制：noentry⟧ (regulation) + ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (clothes).

TYPES OF UNIFORMS:
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧{制服|せいふく} (school uniform)
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制服|せいふく} (company uniform)
- ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制服|せいふく} (police uniform)
- ⟦{軍服|ぐんぷく}→軍服：21281_gunpuku⟧ (military uniform)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {制服|せいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ (to wear a uniform)
- {制服|せいふく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧ (to change into uniform)
- {制服|せいふく}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (in uniform)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese school uniforms are an iconic part of student life. Most junior high and high schools require uniforms, and they have become a significant aspect of Japanese pop culture.
